import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0114 (a b c : ℝ) (h_a_ne_0 : a ≠ 0) (x1 x2 : ℝ) (hx1 : x1 < x2) : 
  (∀ x ∈ (x1, x2), a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0) ↔ (a > 0 ∧ b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0114 (a b c : ℝ) (h_a_ne_0 : a ≠ 0) (x1 x2 : ℝ) (hx1 : x1 < x2) : 
  (∀ x ∈ (x1, x2), a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0) ↔ (a > 0 ∧ b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0) := by
  split
  · intro h_pos
    have h_discr : b^2 - 4 * a * c < 0 := by
      have h_pos2 : a * x1^2 + b * x1 + c > 0 := h_pos x1
      have h_pos2 : a * x2^2 + b * x2 + c > 0 := h_pos x2
      have h_mid : a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 for x : ℝ where x1 < x ∧ x < x2 := by
        have h_mid1 : a * x1^2 + b * x1 + c > 0 := h_pos x1
        have h_mid2 : a * x2^2 + b * x2 + c > 0 := h_pos x2
        have h_mid3 : a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by
          have h_mid4 : a * x^2 + b * x + c = a * (x - x1) * (x - x2) + (a * x1^2 + b * x1 + c) + (a * x2^2 + b * x2 + c) - (a * x1^2 + b * x1 + c) - (a * x2^2 + b * x2 + c) := by
            ring
          have h_mid5 : a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by
            have h_mid6 : a * (x - x1) * (x - x2) > 0 := by
              have h_mid7 : x - x1 > 0 ∧ x - x2 < 0 := by
                have h_mid8 : x1 < x ∧ x < x2 := by assumption
                have h_mid9 : x - x1 > 0 := by linarith
                have h_mid10 : x - x2 < 0 := by linarith
                exact h_mid8
              exact h_mid7
            exact h_mid6
          exact h_mid5
        exact h_mid3
      exact h_mid
    exact h_discr
  · intro h_discr
    have h_pos : ∀ x ∈ (x1, x2), a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have h_mid : a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by
        have h_mid1 : a * x^2 + b * x + c = a * (x - x1) * (x - x2) + (a * x1^2 + b * x1 + c) + (a * x2^2 + b * x2 + c) - (a * x1^2 + b * x1 + c) - (a * x2^2 + b * x2 + c) := by
          ring
        have h_mid2 : a * x^2 + b * x + c > 0 := by
          have h_mid3 : a * (x - x1) * (x - x2) > 0 := by
            have h_mid4 : x - x1 > 0 ∧ x - x2 < 0 := by
              have h_mid5 : x1 < x ∧ x < x2 := by assumption
              have h_mid6 : x - x1 > 0 := by linarith
              have h_mid7 : x - x2 < 0 := by linarith
              exact h_mid5
            exact h_mid4
          exact h_mid3
        exact h_mid2
      exact h_mid
    exact h_pos
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0114 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0114 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0114

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0114
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0114
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
